headline: Chinese Automakers Gear Up European Production to Sidestep Tariffs
summary: Chinese carmakers facing European Union import quotas are planning to set up local factories or tap international plants to sustain their sales boom.
why: European trade restrictions and import quotas directly impact the international expansion and margin profiles of Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Shifting production into Europe helps automakers bypass import tariffs and trade quotas.
